'''Empeth Crystals''' were a type of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhancing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that grew in the [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]], a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. The Empeth Crystals grew once every ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. They were cube-shaped, and when picked were nearly indestructible. When worn by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the crystals could locate the Force in other sentient beings. Once picked, the crystals lived for five years before becoming simple rock. In the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the crystals were protected by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]], the ruler of the planet, who has assigned a part of the [[King's Own Guard]] to watch over them.
